comments.content:
This part had multiple problems and I tried to address some with this fix I didn't want to put more time into this because the work I was doing was unrelated to this. But let's see what is needed now. 
- before you use in, and exclude out, this part needs to deal with out/in with a single value. It was treating properly the fully qualified repository name "GithubAccountName/RepostioryName", but if it was just "GithubAccountName", it treated it as "RepostioryName" That is why I had to put a check to only use a fully qualified repository name. This needs to be fixed. https://github.com/ubiquity/devpool-directory/blob/131e16d78d245c1f4bf03e31b6935ad78900d450/tests/main.test.ts#L28
-  after the above fix, use the in, and exclude the out. 
- also move the mocks folder out of the root directory into the test folder. mocks are only used by tests so they should live together.

One suggestion is always to use a full repository name in opt.json "GithubAccountName/RepostioryName", and it will make out/in redundant. This will result in lesser & cleaner code, less requests, and clear intent. But it is just a suggestion as this will require redoing a few parts and I was not the part of initial discussion on this. But @pavlovcik has the final say on this.
